quarterly_data.quarter: Sanofi press release: Press Release: Sanofi's MenQuadfi approved in the EU for (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The European Commission approved an extension of the indication for MenQuadfi (meningococcal group A, C, W and Y conjugate vaccine) to infants from six weeks of age against invasive meningococcal disease caused by Neisseria meningitidis serogroups A, C, W and Y; it was previously approved in the EU for individuals aged 12 months and older. The extension follows the positive CHMP opinion adopted on June 25, 2026 and is supported by the MET58 pivotal study of immunogenicity, safety and tolerability in infants from six weeks of age. Sanofi says the expanded indication aligns with routine infant immunization schedules.
